entries.title: ReConfig 3.3.0 — Profiles and HUD polish
entries.description: Your profile now has an articulated skin preview, Minecraft-font nametag, five-character tag editor, editable bio, emoji controls and separate public-profile search. HUD labels and merged backgrounds no longer add unwanted dark shadows.

entries.title: Build and verification
entries.description: The Fabric build and Gradle checks pass, including the mixin audit. Source and backend regression suites pass. Running Minecraft verification remains required. Five-character tags need the included Worker update.
